name: manual_4cba77
claim: On Windows Python 3.13+, prefer 'netifaces2' over the original 'netifaces' package — the original has no prebuilt wheel past Python 3.11 and fails to build from source without MSVC build tools; netifaces2 is a maintained drop-in fork (same 'import netifaces' API) with prebuilt wheels for current Python.

decisions.notes: requirements-windows.txt pinned netifaces>=0.11.0, which broke the entire fresh-install bootstrap chain on Python 3.13.14 (wheel build failure, no MSVC installed). Swapped to netifaces2>=0.0.22 with zero code changes needed downstream (discover.py, ip_detection_solution.py both already treat the import as optional via try/except).
